startUrls.title: Shopee shop or product links
startUrls.description: Shop links (https://shopee.sg/shop/64922680 or https://shopee.sg/<shop-username>) or product links (https://shopee.sg/product/<shop>/<item> or any ...-i.<shop>.<item> link), from any of the 8 countries. A shop returns its newest reviews across all products; a product returns only its own reviews (read from its shop's reviews, see 'Max reviews'). Also accepts 'urls', 'productUrls', 'shopUrls' and 'url'.

shopIds.title: Shops by id or username
shopIds.description: Numeric shop ids (64922680) or shop usernames (ugreen.sg). Uses the Country below. Also accepts 'shops'.

country.title: Country
country.description: Shopee country for shop ids and usernames. Links always use the country of their own domain.

maxReviews.title: Max reviews per shop or product
maxReviews.description: Reviews delivered per input, newest first. The most you can get from one shop is 5,000. For a product, the Actor reads its shop's reviews (up to that same limit) and keeps the ones of that product: a product of a very large shop may have fewer reviews in reach.

minRating.title: Min stars
minRating.description: Only reviews with at least this many stars (1 to 5). Set min 1 and max 2 to get only complaints.

maxRating.title: Max stars
maxRating.description: Only reviews with at most this many stars (1 to 5). Filtering by stars reaches further back in time.

onlyWithComment.title: Only reviews with a written comment
onlyWithComment.description: Skip star-only reviews. Skipped reviews are not charged.

onlyWithMedia.title: Only reviews with photos or videos
onlyWithMedia.description: Keep only reviews where the buyer attached at least one photo or video. The output has the counts, not the files.

newerThan.title: Only reviews newer than
newerThan.description: A date (2026-09-01) or a period (30 days, 2 weeks, 6 months). Reading stops at the first older review, so a daily or weekly schedule only pays for what is new.

includeShopSummary.title: Add a shop summary row
includeShopSummary.description: Adds one free row (type 'shop') per shop: name, username, link, shop rating, total reviews split into good / normal / bad, followers, products, response rate, official badge and join date.
